'''Polearm Five ''' flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] as part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]]. During the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], this [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|battle for the ''Razor's Kiss'']] from a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] shot from the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].<ref name="if" />
